The '''Thalak''' was a tribe of [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] operating in the [[Nightmare Lands]] of [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
During the Cold War the Voss, concerned about the Thalak, tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team with reducing their capabilities. The tribe's trained [[Mawvorr]] and [[Vorantikus]] were slained alongside the tribesman. The [[Thalak Tribal Chieftain|Chieftain]] was also killed.

==Behind the scenes==
The Thalak are the enemies of the heroic mission Not Afraid Enough in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
